records.source: 大巌竜の素材を用いた腰防具。{j}加工された今なお大地の鼓動{j}の如く脈打つ腰用装備。
records.previous: Waist equipment made from Great Boulder Dragon materials.{j}Even after being processed, it pulses like the heartbeat{j}of the earth.
records.target: Waist gear made from Great Boulder Dragon.{j}Even after processing, it pulses like{j}the earth's heartbeat.

records.source: 大巌竜の素材を用いた腰防具。{j}数々の戦いの記憶が刻み込ま{j}れ、身に付けた者に甦る。
records.previous: Waist armor made from Great Boulder Dragon materials.{j}The memories of countless battles are engraved{j}into it, reviving in the wearer.
records.target: Great Boulder Dragon waist armor.{j}Countless battle memories are engraved{j}within, awakening in its wearer.

records.source: ランポスの素材を用いた腰{j}防具。素材、設計を一から{j}見直し機能性強化を実現。
records.previous: Waist{j}armor using Velociprey materials. Reviewing materials and design from scratch{j}, functionality enhancement was achieved.
records.target: Waist{j}armor using Velociprey materials.{j}A full redesign improves functionality.

records.source: 棘竜の素材を用いた腰防具。{j}工房技術の進歩により、さ{j}らに改良を加えられた。
records.previous: Waist armor made from Espinas materials.{j}Due to the advancement of workshop technology, further{j}improvements were made.
records.target: Waist armor made from Espinas materials.{j}Workshop advances have enabled{j}further improvements.

records.source: エスピナス希少種の特徴を参{j}考にして作成された、聴覚保護{j}特化ガンナー用腰防具。
records.previous: Created with reference{j}to the traits of the Espinas Rare Species, this waist armor is for Gunners specialized in Hearing Protection{j}.
records.target: Waist armor for Hearing Protection Gunners{j}based on Espinas Rare Species traits.{j}Built for specialized hearing protection.

records.source: 赤闘獣の紅毛や極鉄など素材{j}で生産した重厚な腰防具。{j}精巧な金属細工が美しい。
records.previous: Heavy Waist armor crafted from{j}materials such as the Red Violent Beast's crimson fur and extreme iron.{j}Its intricate metalwork is beautiful.
records.target: Heavy waist armor of crimson fur and iron.{j}Crafted from Red Violent Beast materials.{j}Beautiful intricate metalwork.

records.source: 漆黒の合金で作られた脚装備。{j}どれだけ磨いても決して光ら{j}ず、奈落の闇に染まり続ける。
records.previous: Leg equipment made from a jet-black alloy.{j}No matter how much you polish it, it will never{j}shine, forever steeped in the darkness of the abyss.
records.target: Leg gear made from jet-black alloy.{j}No polish can make it shine; it remains{j}steeped in abyssal darkness.

records.source: 街を守護するという騎士の、{j}脚用装備の廉価版。一見無骨{j}だが、精密な構造で隙がない。
records.previous: A budget version of the{j}leg armor of the knight said to guard the town.{j}Rough at a glance, yet its precise construction leaves no gaps.
records.target: Budget leg armor for town guards.{j}Rough at a glance, but precisely built{j}leaves no gaps.

records.source: 街を守護するという騎士の、{j}脚用装備の廉価版。性能面で{j}の妥協は一切無い。男性専用。
records.previous: A budget version of the{j}leg armor of the knight said to guard the town. In terms of performance,{j}there is no compromise at all. Men only.
records.target: Budget leg armor for town guards.{j}Performance has no compromises.{j}For men only.

records.source: 東方の衣装を真似た脚用装備。{j}黒狼鳥素材の装甲が発する{j}熱は、脚に力をみなぎらせる。
records.previous: Leg armor that imitates Eastern attire.{j}The armor made from Yian Garuga materials gives off a heat{j}that fills your legs with power.
records.target: Leg armor imitating Eastern attire.{j}Yian Garuga armor heat fills your legs{j}with power.

scope: Ten exact-source waist- and leg-armor description patterns.
